noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

unitPath.description:
Path from which unit data can be extracted; should be of the form "parent.field" where field is field on
the parent

treatment.description: Treatment to be applied when normalizing. Refer to {@link AggOp}

treatmentPath.description:
If the treatment varies by instance, we can use a treatment path to determine the
treatment to be applied for this timeseries field

normalizer.description:
Name of the type which implements "normalize" function @see Normalizer
for this timeseries field. Useful when user needs to provide a custom
normalization logic

valueMapping.description: Providing the mapping from code to its numeric equivalent

norm.description:
onLoad     - normalize as soon as data comes in (eagerly)
onDemand   - normalize when data is requested
raw        - assume that raw data has no irregularities and simply pass through raw data
enum ("onLoad", "onDemand", "raw")

persist.description:
always     - after normalization, persist it in the datastore
never      - don't persist after normalization - satisfy all requests for data by normalizing in-memory
optional   - the platform gets to decide whether or not to persist normalized data
enum ("always", "never", "optional")
